messages:
Alicia (growth): Heads up — for this week's KPI review I noticed the leads -> MQL conversion dropped from ~6% to ~3% last week. Anyone else seeing weird splits? :eyes:
Matt K (analytics): Looking now. There's a mismatch between Looker and HubSpot — HubSpot shows ~310 leads, Looker ~420. My hunch is UTM parsing / lost querystrings.
Sam (demand gen): We swapped the webinar landing redirect on Wed. Could be stripping utm params on redirect.
Alicia (growth): Ah. @Matt K can you run a raw event pull for /webinar/thank-you and check how many have null utm_source?
Matt K (analytics): On it. Quick SQL I'm running: `SELECT count(*) as pv, sum(case when utm_source IS NULL then 1 else 0 end) as missing_utm FROM page_views WHERE path = '/webinar/thank-you' AND received_at >= '2026-03-09'` — prelim: 420 pv, ~110 missing utm.
Jess (ops): We enabled a CDN redirect rule for that path on 2026-03-11 to shorten the URL — default rule may have been dropping query params unless `preserveQuery` was true. Fixing now.
Alicia (growth): Ok that would explain it. So attribution is undercounting email/ads and inflating 'direct'. What should we present on the KPI board for Friday?
Sam (demand gen): Suggest showing two numbers: "tracked leads (utm present)" and "total leads" with a short note about the redirect. We can apply a correction factor for last 2 weeks in the narrative.
Matt K (analytics): I can add a derived dimension in Looker: `coalesce(utm_source,'(unknown)')` and a toggle to show adjusted totals. Need ~2 hours to add model +explore change and re-run dashboard tiles.
Alicia (growth): OK go ahead. @data-bot can you kick the batch reprocess for 2026-03-09..2026-03-15 to rehydrate utm fields from raw logs? Need numbers before Friday EOD.
data-bot: Scheduled job `reprocess-utm-20260309-15` — queued. Estimated runtime ~45m. I'll post status when done.
Jess (ops): I've rolled back the CDN rule and set `preserveQuery=true`. Watching for dropped requests. Will post logs if anything else looks off.
Sam (demand gen): Also let's add a small param `cta_variant=webinar_v1` to email links so we can separate email CTA tests from organic landing variants going forward.
Alicia (growth): Good plan. For the weekly review I'll prepare a slide: "Attribution variance due to CDN redirect — showing both tracked vs total; corrected looker metric applied." Please add Looker screenshot once tiles refresh.
Matt K (analytics): Will post screenshot + link to updated dashboard once reprocess completes.
Alicia (growth): Thanks all. I'll update the Friday agenda to add a 5-min item under Data reliability. :white_check_mark:
Sam (demand gen): noted.
Jess (ops): ✅
